title: Elon Musk pledges a share of SpaceX company to 'every kid in America' - The Economic Times
text:
In a groundbreaking move, Elon Musk revealed his intention to distribute one share of SpaceX to every child in America. This announcement comes on the heels of Anthropic's commitment to allocate 5 percent of its shares to a public benefit fund aimed at harmonizing financial success with social impacts. With SpaceX recently hitting the stock market, Musk has also claimed the title of the world's first trillionaire.
